slices.title: Content version and surfaced upload failure
slices.summary: Defines the workspace content version as the sha256 of the redacted bytes, equal to the CAS put hash, and makes an upload or snapshot failure visible: upload_and_discard_workspace returns WorkspaceUploadOutcome with uploaded=false, a workspace_upload_failed counter increments, and the run summary says the workspace changes were not saved. Counters only; no new persistence.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib workspace_hydrate sandbox_lease

decisions_defaults.DEC-24: (a) per-run overlay now, truthful tool text `durability: 'run_overlay'`; (c) explicit accept later; no promote caller here. Rung `workspace_write`, class `context_write`, no per-call approval; plan mode and subagents refuse it.

slices.title: Skill bundle store and API in capability-core
slices.summary: Add an org-scoped skill bundle store in capability-core (manifest, per-file rows, digest-addressed blobs in Postgres, never global) with admin-only, flag-gated PUT, GET and DELETE routes, three read RPCs (ListSkillBundles, GetSkillBundleManifest, GetSkillBlob) and audit events. Caps are 256 files, 8 MiB total and 1 MiB per file, with SKILL.md required; bundles do not touch agent_skills.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/go/services/capability-core" && go test ./... && go vet ./...
slices.flag: SKILL_BUNDLES_ENABLED (capability-core, default off; upload returns 404 when off; tables remain on rollback)
